Do you have experience operating an EPT or stacker and are you looking for a new challenge in logistics?

What are you going to do?
As a Warehouse Operator, you will be responsible for:

- Transporting materials to and from the production floor
- Ensuring a seamless flow of goods to prevent delays or disruptions in production
- Identifying and resolving discrepancies or operational issues, escalating when necessary
- Supporting inventory management through stock counts and checks
- Maintaining accurate records and following warehouse procedures
- Working closely with colleagues and supervisors to achieve daily targets
- Operating an EPT and stacker safely and efficiently

What do we offer?
- Starting salary of €15.68 gross per hour
- 18% shift allowance on top of your hourly wage
- Full-time position with long-term opportunities
- A dynamic and international working environment
- Training and development opportunities
- Work within a professional and supportive team

Where will you work?
The company is a leading logistics service provider within the high-tech industry. It specializes in the packaging, storage, cleaning, and transportation of high-value and sensitive components for customers worldwide. From its modern facility in Eindhoven, you will work in a professional environment where quality, precision, and teamwork are at the heart of everything they do.

What do we ask?
- VMBO level of education or equivalent
- Good command of English (minimum B1 level)
- Experience with or certification for an EPT and stacker (required)
- Accurate and quality-focused way of working
- Team player with strong communication skills
- Flexible attitude and willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Ability to work independently and take responsibility

Are you interested?
Apply today and become part of a team where your contribution directly impacts the success of the production process. We look forward to hearing from you!

Prinsen is a very nice company which is specialized in powdered food products. Such as sports nutrition and diet shakes. At Prinsen there is a pleasant working atmosphere where all employees are treated equally.
